products.name: LoopPilot
products.desc: LoopPilot is a Windows engineering platform for loop readiness, instrument validation and PID advisory. It brings sample or acquired PV, SP and MV data into a structured read-only workflow, checks data quality and loop health, supports plant-style instrument HMI review, and produces engineering evidence and reports. LoopPilot helps engineers identify instrumentation, valve and process limitations before recommending tuning changes. It is advisory software only and does not write to the PLC or DCS.
products.shortDescription: Loop readiness, instrument validation and PID advisory software for engineers who need safer, evidence-based control-loop assessment before tuning.
